paper_title: (Almost) Closing the nuMSM Sterile Neutrino Dark Matter Window with NuSTAR
notes: This paper sets limits on sterile neutrino dark matter (nuMSM) in the plane of sterile neutrino mass (keV) vs mixing angle sin^2(2theta), from a NuSTAR X-ray line search toward the Galactic Center (Fig. 1). Sterile neutrinos are not among the boson couplings in the task card table (axion-photon/electron/nucleon/EDM, dark photon, B-L, scalar, monopole-dipole, etc.). The reported exclusion is on sin^2(2theta) vs m_chi, which does not map to any canonical coupling plane. Therefore is_new_limit is false and no points are emitted. coupling_convention field is set to a placeholder default; it is not applicable.
